title: The Admission That Cost Doom His World
description: Part 3 of an original spoiler recap and commentary about Marvel Comics Secret Wars (2015), written by Jonathan Hickman and drawn by Esad Ribic. Comics canon, not a prediction of the MCU films.
hook: Doctor Doom lost his godhood. Miles Morales got his mother back.
payoff: The battle changed who held the power. The hamburger changed who Miles came home to.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Doctor Doom lost his godhood. Miles Morales got his mother back.
units.onscreen: A GOD FALLS. A FAMILY RETURNS.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: A GOD FALLS. A FAMILY RETURNS.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In Secret Wars' final battle, Reed Richards challenged Doom's rule.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: REED CHALLENGES DOOM

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Doom finally admitted Reed could have saved reality better than he had.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: REED COULD HAVE DONE BETTER

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Molecule Man chose to move the power from Doom to Reed.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: DOOM → REED

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Reed and his family then helped rebuild the multiverse, rather than leave one patchwork world.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: WORLDS REBUILT

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: And Molecule Man remembered the meal Miles had given him underground.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: THE HAMBURGER MATTERED

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He gave Miles a place in the rebuilt reality—and brought his mother back.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: MILES GETS HIS MOTHER BACK

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The battle changed who held the power. The hamburger changed who Miles came home to.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: THE FAVOR REPAID
